text:
**Sunday**, and the week ahead is short: school on Monday and Tuesday, then Thanksgiving Break from **Wednesday** through the following Monday.

Nothing is due before the break. That makes this a good week to let the review list sit untouched and still be useful later.

On the far side of the break, the 9th Grade Night is **December 2** and Pre-Comp review week starts **December 7**. One topic from the list over the break is enough. Two is showing off.
